summary: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a block admission application for 43,616,756 ordinary shares to be admitted to trading on AIM, issuable upon exercise of options under the 2026 Share Option Scheme approved at the AGM on May 12, 2026. No price, premium, or consideration is involved as this is a routine equity incentive plan administration. The existing block admission for the 2015 scheme remains in effect. This is a standard share issuance mechanism, not a special situation.
